title: LongGuard: Mechanistic Analysis and Training-Free Mitigation of Long-Context Failure in Safety Guardrails
abstract: arXiv:2608.27580v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safety guardrails serve as the last line of defense against harmful inputs and outputs of large language models (LLMs), yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on short text. We present LongGuard, a framework that evaluates, mechanistically analyzes, and mitigates long-context guardrail failure. We formulate the task as Safety Needle-in-a-Haystack (SafetyNIAH) over a 0.25k-32k length grid; across 15 mainstream guardrails, unsafe recall drops monotonically by more than 50% on average, and a paired Benign-Fill vs. Needle-Repeat design attributes the failure to proportional dilution of the unsafe needle rather than to absolute length. A three-layer attention-logit-behavior analysis on six guardrails locates the mechanism: attention mass on the unsafe needle is diluted, the unsafe-over-safe logit margin is compressed in lockstep, and the detection decision collapses accordingly, with this attention->logit->behavior chain re

translated_title: LongGuard：安全护栏长上下文失效的机制分析与免训练缓解方法
translated_abstract: 安全护栏是抵御大语言模型（LLM）有害输入与输出的最后一道防线，然而其训练与评估几乎完全基于短文本。我们提出LongGuard，一个用于评估、机制性分析并缓解长上下文护栏失效的框架。我们将该任务形式化为“安全大海捞针”（SafetyNIAH）问题，并在0.25k至32k的长度网格上进行测试；在15个主流护栏上，不安全内容的召回率平均单调下降超过50%，且通过配对的“良性填充 vs. 针重复”实验设计，我们将失效归因于不安全“针”的比例稀释，而非绝对长度本身。对六个护栏进行的三层“注意力-逻辑值-行为”分析定位了失效机制：作用于不安全针上的注意力质量被稀释，不安全相对安全的逻辑值差距同步被压缩，检测决策随之崩溃，这一“注意力->逻辑值->行为”链条（摘要内容在此处被截断）……
tldr: 本文提出LongGuard框架，通过“安全大海捞针”测试揭示安全护栏在长上下文中失效的机制——不安全内容的注意力被比例性稀释并沿“注意力->逻辑值->行为”链条传导导致检测崩溃，并给出免训练的缓解方法。
en_tdlr: LongGuard reveals that long-context failures of safety guardrails stem from proportional dilution of attention on unsafe content propagating through an attention->logit->behavior chain, and provides a training-free mitigation.
